subject: planner: fix no access path when TiKV read is disabled under RC isolation (#65127)
summary: Adjusts `findBestTask4LogicalDataSource` to only apply isolation-read engine filtering (and the TiFlash-pruning workaround for point-get paths in explicit transactions) when TiKV is actually enabled in `tidb_isolation_read_engines`, preventing “No access path” errors when TiKV is disabled under RC. Also broadens the TiFlash-specific help text in `FilterPathByIsolationRead` to trigger whenever the isolation engine list includes `tiflash` (not only when it equals `tiflash`).
